hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { uv sync --locked --quiet 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: uv sync failed, proceeding with existing env'; } && echo '--- Baseline Test Run ---' && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; uv run pytest -x -q --tb=line 2>&1 | tail -8'

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.py$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff check --no-fix "$FILE" 2>&1; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo '=== Quality Gate ===' && { uv run ruff check . 2>&1 || true; } && echo '---' && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; uv run pytest -x -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -15'
